title: whose 与谓语的数

examples.en: This is the boy whose father is a doctor.
examples.zh: 这就是那个父亲当医生的男孩。

examples.en: He is one of the students who are good at English.
examples.zh: 他是擅长英语的学生之一。

guess.question: “He is one of the boys who ____ football.” 谓语该用 is 还是 are？

options.text: are——先行词是 the boys，是复数
options.feedback: 对！one of 后面接的复数名词才是先行词，谓语跟它走。
不对——先行词是 the boys，不是 one。
不对——有明确规则：one of 后跟复数谓语，the only one of 后跟单数谓语。

rule.rule: whose + 名词表示“……的”，先行词是人和物都可以用；one of + 复数名词 + who / that 引导的从句谓语用复数；the only one of… 后的谓语用单数
rule.formula: ① whose + 名词：The girl whose mother is a teacher…　② one of the + 复数 + who + 复数谓语：He is one of the boys who are…　③ the only one of + 复数 + who + 单数谓语　④ whose 也可指物：The house whose windows are broken…

anchors.en: The house whose windows are broken is empty.
anchors.zh: 窗户破了的那座房子是空的。

anchors.en: He is one of the students who have passed the exam.
anchors.zh: 他是通过考试的学生之一。

trap.wrong: He is one of the boys who is tall.
trap.right: He is one of the boys who are tall.
trap.why: 先行词是 the boys（复数），谓语要跟它一致，用 are。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——whose 后面一定跟名词；one of 后面的从句谓语用复数，只有 the only one of 才用单数。

check.stem: This is the girl ____ mother is a nurse.

options.distractor: 表示“她的妈妈”要用 whose

check.explanation: 表示所属关系 → whose mother。

check.stem: He is one of the students who ____ good at maths.
check.explanation: 先行词是 the students → 谓语用 are。

options.text: The room whose window is open is mine.
The room which window is open is mine.
The room that window is open is mine.
The room what window is open is mine.

check.explanation: whose 指物也可以：the room whose window。
